description:
Convert a FlatGeobuf file (base64-encoded .fgb) to a GeoJSON
    FeatureCollection. FlatGeobuf is a cloud-native binary format with a
    built-in spatial index, used for fast HTTP-range-request streaming
    (e.g. deck.gl, MapLibre, QGIS cloud layers).

    Returns the GeoJSON FeatureCollection as a JSON string.
name: flatgeobuf_to_geojson
